summary: FVCBankcorp, Inc. filed an 8-K to furnish a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 earnings results and to report a board-declared cash dividend of $0.07 per share. The filing contains routine quarterly financial disclosures and a standard dividend declaration, neither of which constitutes a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or activist event. No extraordinary corporate action is described. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, thus it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
